name: boolean_literal_function_argument
source:
LET result = TYPEOF(true)
SAY result
reason: RexxAE retains the boolean type of a direct function argument; this RexxJS parser path resolves the literal as text. Assigned booleans and JSON_PARSE('true') are compatible.

name: single_quoted_object_keys
reason: RexxAE parses object keys quoted in either style; RexxJS recognizes JSON double-quoted object keys here and leaves the single-quoted form as text.

name: array_literal_function_argument
source:
LET result = LENGTH([1,2,3])
SAY result
reason: RexxAE retains direct array literals as typed arguments. RexxJS splits this literal at commas on this call-parser path. Assign the array to a variable for shared syntax.

name: return_result_parser
source:
CALL work
SAY RESULT
EXIT
work:
LET RESULT = 7
RETURN RESULT
reason: RexxJS parses RETURN RESULT as a RESULT() function call and dispatches a default host command. RexxAE reads the variable. Use LET answer = RESULT followed by RETURN answer for shared syntax.

name: condition_multiple_function_terms
source:
SELECT
WHEN ABS(2) + ABS(3) > 4 THEN SAY 'match'
OTHERWISE SAY 'fallback'
END
reason: The RexxJS condition resolver consumes this compound function expression as one function call. RexxAE evaluates the arithmetic expression. Assign the sum to a variable before WHEN for shared syntax.

name: explicit_parse_with
source:
LET line = 'one two three'
PARSE VAR line WITH a b
SAY a
SAY b
PARSE VALUE line WITH a b
SAY a
SAY b
reason: RexxJS treats WITH as a template variable in these parser paths. RexxAE recognizes the explicit separator. Omit WITH for the shared simple-input profile.

name: object_assignment_aliases
source:
LET data.x = 7
LET alias = data
LET data.x = 8
SAY alias.x data.x
reason: RexxAE owns copied values; RexxJS shares object identity across variable assignment. This difference now has an observable compound-write example.

name: power_binds_tighter_than_multiply
source:
LET a = 2 * 3 ** 2
SAY a
reason: Classic Rexx evaluates ** before * and / (2 * 3 ** 2 is 18). RexxJS gives ** a lower precedence than * and / (36); a suspected RexxJS bug, in docs/rexxjs-suggestions.md.

name: do_for_count
source:
DO i = 1 TO 10 FOR 2
SAY i
END
reason: Classic Rexx stops a controlled loop after FOR count iterations. RexxJS ignores FOR and runs to TO; a suspected RexxJS bug (docs/rexxjs-suggestions.md).

name: do_range_while
source:
DO i = 1 TO 5 WHILE i < 3
SAY i
END
reason: Classic Rexx tests WHILE before each iteration of a controlled loop. RexxJS ignores the WHILE; a suspected RexxJS bug (docs/rexxjs-suggestions.md). RexxAE used to misparse it as part of the TO expression and print 1 and 0.

name: do_range_until
source:
DO i = 1 TO 5 UNTIL i = 2
SAY i
END
reason: Classic Rexx tests UNTIL after each iteration of a controlled loop. RexxJS reads UNTIL i = 2 into the TO expression (1, then 0); a suspected RexxJS bug (docs/rexxjs-suggestions.md).

name: datatype_classic_option
source:
LET a = DATATYPE('12', 'W')
SAY a
reason: Classic DATATYPE(string, option) takes one of the letters A B L M N S U W X and answers 1 or 0. RexxJS compares the option with its type names (NUM, CHAR, ...) and answers false for every letter. RexxAE answers RexxJS's type names as RexxJS does and the letters as classic Rexx does; the letters are a suggested RexxJS addition.

name: datatype_hex_text
source:
LET a = DATATYPE('0x1F')
SAY a
reason: RexxJS's DATATYPE takes JavaScript's Number() syntax, so 0x1F (and 0b1, 0o7) is NUM; classic Rexx has no such number syntax (CHAR). A suspected RexxJS bug.

name: symbol_constant
source:
LET a = SYMBOL('12')
SAY a
reason: Classic SYMBOL gives LIT for a constant symbol (one starting with a digit or a point). RexxJS's name pattern rejects it as BAD. A suspected RexxJS bug.

name: pull_uppercases
source:
PUSH 'b'
PULL x
SAY x
reason: Classic PULL is PARSE UPPER PULL and uppercases the line. RexxJS's PULL keeps the case. A suspected RexxJS bug (docs/rexxjs-suggestions.md); PARSE PULL keeps the case in RexxAE.

name: parse_pull
source:
PUSH 'Hello World'
PARSE PULL a b
SAY a b
reason: Classic PARSE PULL (and PARSE UPPER/LOWER) is in RexxAE; RexxJS has neither and sends the clause to the default ADDRESS environment, after which a and b are unset. A suggested RexxJS addition.

name: parse_upper_var
source:
s = 'Hello World'
PARSE UPPER VAR s a b
SAY a b
reason: Classic PARSE UPPER VAR; RexxJS sends the clause to the default ADDRESS environment. A suggested RexxJS addition.

name: exit_unless_message_expression
source:
x = 5
EXIT UNLESS x > 9, 'x is' x
SAY 'no'
reason: RexxAE evaluates EXIT UNLESS's message as an expression. RexxJS evaluates it only when it contains ||, and otherwise prints its source text. A suspected RexxJS bug.

name: array_slice_positional
source:
LET a = JSON_PARSE('[3,1,2,4]')
LET r = ARRAY_SLICE(a, 1, 3)
SAY JSON_STRINGIFY(r)
reason: RexxAE slices positionally as Array.prototype.slice does. RexxJS's positional converter for ARRAY_SLICE drops start and end (named start= and end= work), so the whole array comes back. A suspected RexxJS bug in parameter-converter.js.

name: array_includes_positional
source:
LET a = JSON_PARSE('[3,1]')
LET r = ARRAY_INCLUDES(a, 1)
LET i = ARRAY_INDEXOF(a, 1)
SAY r i
reason: RexxAE finds a positional item by JavaScript's SameValueZero. RexxJS's positional converter for ARRAY_INCLUDES and ARRAY_INDEXOF loses the item (a named item= works). A suspected RexxJS bug in parameter-converter.js.

name: extension_cron_valid
source:
LET x = CRON_VALID('0 0 * * *')
SAY x
reason: RexxAE extension, not parity: RexxJS has no CRON_VALID, so its LET sends the unknown call to the default ADDRESS environment as a command. Recorded until RexxJS gains the same function (TODO.md).

name: extension_cron_next
source:
LET x = CRON_NEXT('@daily', '2026-11-03T16:49:32.123Z')
SAY x
reason: RexxAE extension, not parity: RexxJS has no CRON_NEXT, so its LET sends the unknown call to the default ADDRESS environment as a command. Recorded until RexxJS gains the same function (TODO.md).

name: extension_log_info
source:
LET r = LOG_INFO('hello')
SAY 'after' r
reason: RexxAE extension, not parity: RexxJS has no LOG_INFO (or any LOG_ level function), so its LET sends the unknown call to the default ADDRESS environment as a command. Recorded until RexxJS gains the same function (TODO.md). Logging is off by default, so the native run has no LOG event.
